milestones.name: Purchase Greenpath Map
milestones.note: Player is prompted to buy a map of the area for 60 Geo from Cornifer

milestones.name: Reach Hornet Boss Arena
milestones.note: Player navigates through Greenpath to reach Hornet's boss room

milestones.name: Defeat Hornet
milestones.note: Defeating Hornet drops the Mothwing Cloak (dash ability)

milestones.name: Obtain Mothwing Cloak
milestones.note: Rewarded after defeating Hornet in Greenpath

zones.name: Greenpath
zones.fingerprintHint: Lush green cave environment with hanging moss, glowing teal lighting, and vine-covered walls
zones.note: Zone where Mothwing Cloak is obtained by defeating Hornet

abilities.name: Mothwing Cloak
abilities.note: Dropped by Hornet upon defeat; also referred to as the dash ability

abilities.name: Vengeful Spirit
abilities.note: Required to progress past a specific enemy blocking the path in Greenpath; referenced as a prerequisite

bosses.name: Hornet
bosses.note: Boss fight at the end of Greenpath; defeating her rewards the Mothwing Cloak

objectives.name: Buy map from Cornifer
objectives.hopDescription: Spend 60 Geo to purchase the Greenpath map from Cornifer
objectives.note: Player has 105 Geo at time of prompt; map costs 60 Geo

objectives.name: Navigate left through Greenpath
objectives.hopDescription: Hug left walls and descend midway to find the correct path through Greenpath

objectives.name: Use Vengeful Spirit to pass blocking enemy
objectives.hopDescription: Defeat the enemy blocking progression using Vengeful Spirit

objectives.name: Reach the three pillars area
objectives.hopDescription: Navigate to the top-left area of Greenpath marked by three pillar-like structures to locate Hornet's arena

objectives.name: Defeat Hornet to unlock dash
objectives.hopDescription: Enter Hornet's boss room and defeat her to obtain the Mothwing Cloak

connectors.description: Follow the path left and upward through Greenpath, past bench and save points, to reach Hornet's sealed boss room
connectors.note: Mothwing Cloak not yet acquired; several jumps noted as impossible without it
